company.name: SparkGift
company.shortDescription: SparkGift makes it easy to send stocks and index funds as gifts to friends and family.
company.description: SparkGift makes it insanely easy to give investments as gifts (stocks and ETFs).  Instead of giving a $50 gift card, you could give $50 of Tesla stock.  They support fractional shares and small dollar gifts.  They are creating an entirely new gift category.  Through investment gifts, they are creating new savers & new investors at scale.
